notes.title: Demo Version 2 Is Out Now!
notes.notes:
[h1]What's New in Demo V2[/h1]

[list]
[*] [b]Spaceships[/b] can now be spotted flying around just outside the windows. There also seems to be a [b]new planet[/b] out there too. I wonder if that has any importance?
[*] [b]Five more corridor variants[/b] for you to try and spot.
[*] [b]Save data and settings[/b] are now included. Unlocking the speedrun mode will now be permanent along with any changes to volume or quality in the settings page.
[*] [b]Bug fixes[/b] including a major issue causing game crashes.
[/list]

[h2]Why This Matters[/h2]

This update gives you a better look at what the full game will be like and helps me to gather more feedback. If you played the first demo, I would love to hear how this one compares.

[h2]How to Play[/h2]

Just go to the [b]store page[/b], hit [b]Download Demo[/b], and you'll get the latest version.

[h2]Thanks for Playing[/h2]

I truly appreciate all of your support. Drop your thoughts in the Discord, it really helps.
- Blott Jeb
